༄༅/ /sman gyi brgyud mchod ni/dbyings kyi yum chen kun bzang mo/ /rdo rje btsun mo gnam zhal ma/ /rab dgyes khros ma nag mo la/ /sman mchod 'ab

tei:div.tei:p: /sman gyi brgyud mchod ni/ dbyings kyi yum chen kun bzang mo/ /rdo rje btsun mo gnam zhal ma/ /rab dgyes khros ma nag mo la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ /rje btsun pad+ma thod phreng rtsal/ /ye shes mtsho rgyal khri srong rje/ /ḍā ki pad+ma mtsho skyid la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ /pad+ma 'od gsal mdo sngags gling*/ /'jam mgon pad+ma gar gyi dbang*/ /rig 'dzin sna tshogs rang grol la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo= /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ /'chi med snang mdzad rdo rje sogs/ /rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma dang*/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ /rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las/ /gnas yul dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma/ /dam tshig 'byung ba'i mkha' 'gro la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dngos grub stsol/ /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ /spyang zhon chen mo mched gsum sogs/ /bka' gter srung ma rgya mtsho dang*/ /'bum phrag yangs pa'i 'khor tshogs la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dngos= /ma hā pañca a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi/ ces pa'ang blo gros mtha' yas kyis so/ 'jam mgon pad+ma gar gyi nas 'chi med snang mdzad rdo rje sogs/ zhes pa'i bar dharma ma tis kha bskang ba'o/
